contracts: (A08 selector executes and all node-applicable records contain node values.) AND (A08 selector executes and every inspected record has a principal.) AND (OperationsBoundaryTests 对每个声明失败族均报告非零发现，公共信封无原始异常/秘密且诊断记录存在并受访问控制。) AND (Selector discovers and verifies the production response and redacted diagnostics contain no existence or path disclosure.) AND (TRX records the exact selector, nonzero discovery, and assertions for all three conflicting scope fields.) AND (Targeted A08 selector discovers and executes, with artifact showing Runner event evidence.) AND (Targeted A08 selector discovers and executes, with artifact showing Snapshot event evidence.) AND (The denied no-store selector is discovered and passes with a no-store header.) AND (The denied-envelope selector is discovered and passes with machine-verifiable bounded/redacted evidence.) AND (The exact selector executes a real private HTTP success request and verifies bounded redacted body plus no-store header.) AND (The exact selector is discovered with nonzero execution, induces an internal failure, and verifies no-store, bounded envelope, and redaction.) AND (The exact selector is discovered, records one-node/no-Worker evidence, and does not launch or depend on Worker services.) AND (The internal-failure selector is discovered and passes with a no-store header.) AND (The real-host OperationsBoundaryTests selector establishes that ACL repair is invoked through the authenticated HTTP boundary.) AND (The real-host OperationsBoundaryTests selector establishes that Restore is invoked through the authenticated HTTP boundary.) AND (The real-host OperationsBoundaryTests selector proves each exercised HTTP operation response has a nonempty stable operation ID.) AND (The real-host OperationsBoundaryTests selector proves post-disconnection re-entry resolves the same stable operation ID for each exercised operation type.) AND (The redaction selector executes with non-skipped assertions and terminal validation confirms absence of path disclosure.) AND (The redaction selector executes with non-skipped assertions and terminal validation confirms no path disclosure.) AND (The successful no-store selector is discovered and passes with a no-store header.) AND (The targeted membership-change selector executes with nonzero discovery and observes a projection matching current server membership.) AND (The targeted role-change selector executes with nonzero discovery and observes a projection matching current server role.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered and proves one new append-only correlated audit record with all required fields and no secret material.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered, executes a non-skipped assertion, and the terminal suite validates the boundary behavior.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered, executes a non-skipped denial assertion, and terminal validation passes.) AND (dotnet test 对 OperationsBoundaryTests 的精确选择器报告非零发现且 ApiEvolution_PreservesExistingClients 通过真实主机。) AND (dotnet test 对 OperationsBoundaryTests 的精确选择器报告非零发现且新增字段兼容断言通过真实主机。)
selector_intents: Execute the SM-I11 nonexistent-target production-boundary selector and fail if access or target data is returned.
Execute the SM-I11 wrong-account ownership selector and fail if another Account's private resource is authorized or returned.
Execute the denied private HTTP envelope selector; fail if the path is not exercised or the envelope is unbounded or unredacted.
Execute the denied private HTTP no-store selector; fail if the denial path is not exercised or caching is permitted.
Execute the internal-failure private HTTP selector; fail if the path is not exercised or Cache-Control lacks no-store.
Execute the nonexistent-target response-redaction selector and fail when any absolute path, relative path, or path-derived detail is observable.
Execute the private HTTP internal-failure selector and fail if no-store, boundedness, or redaction is violated.
Execute the successful private HTTP no-store selector; fail if the success path is not exercised or caching is permitted.
Execute the wrong-account response-redaction selector and fail when any target path or path-derived detail is observable.
Exercise the protected extension-policy administration entry point and inspect persisted audit records for required fields, append-only history, correlation identity, and secret redaction.

Exercise the real authenticated operation readback/re-entry boundary after browser disconnect; fail if the returned stable operation ID cannot locate the durable operation or resolves a different identity.
Inspect each correlated operation-evidence record and fail on any missing or empty principal.
Inspect records marked node-applicable and fail if the node value is absent.
Invoke ACL repair with the real authenticated HTTP client; fail if the operation is absent from that boundary or can only be exercised by a direct service call.
Invoke Restore with the real authenticated HTTP client; fail if the operation is absent from that boundary or can only be exercised by a direct RestoreService call.
OperationsBoundaryTests.TopologySeeds_DoNotCreateAuthority asserts the test environment manifest identifies one node and no Worker fleet before running the behavior checks.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests.NonexistentPrivateResourceResponse asserts the production response envelope omits existence and path indicators for a nonexistent target.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityContextTests.HttpContext_RejectsClientScopeOverride_EmitsMachineEvidence

PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests.PrivateHttp_UsesNoStoreAndBoundedErrors exercises a successful private HTTP request and observes unredacted sensitive data, an unbounded envelope, missing no-store, or no request execution.
PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests.SessionProjection_ExposesServerCapabilities_AfterMembershipChange
PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests.SessionProjection_ExposesServerCapabilities_AfterRoleChange
Run the exact A08 verification selector and fail if its correlated evidence artifact contains no Runner event.
Run the exact A08 verification selector and fail if its correlated evidence artifact contains no Snapshot event.
Submit each exercised operation through authenticated HTTP and observe it again; fail if the response omits operationId or later observation uses a different identity.
对每个失败族检查公共响应脱敏/有界及诊断受控保留；任何原始异常泄露或诊断缺失均失败。
运行 ApiEvolution_PreservesExistingClients 新增字段场景；捕获旧客户端或旧形状出现兼容性变化。
运行 ApiEvolution_PreservesExistingClients 缺失拓扑值场景；若兼容性断言不成立则捕获真实主机行为差异。
